fnthinkReceiveDesc.zh: 开启后才会从服务器收取消息；关闭后既不发送也不接收
fnthinkReceiveDesc.en: Messages are fetched from the server only while this is on; when it is off, neither sending nor receiving occurs.

fnthinkReceiveDisabled.zh: 接收功能未开启，本次操作未执行
fnthinkReceiveDisabled.en: Receiving is disabled; this action was not performed.

fnthinkReceiveSkipped.zh: 上一轮尚未结束，本轮结果将在其结束后显示
fnthinkReceiveSkipped.en: The previous round is still in progress; this round's result will appear after it finishes.

fnthinkPresenceAsleep.zh: 当前未自动运行（开关已关闭，或尚未同意中转）
fnthinkPresenceAsleep.en: Not running automatically right now (the switch is off, or relay consent has not been granted).

fnthinkPresenceDead.zh: 自动恢复链已中断：本机不再自动唤醒（开关与同意均仍开启）
fnthinkPresenceDead.en: The automatic recovery chain is broken: this device will no longer wake on its own (the switch and consent are still enabled).

fnthinkPresenceLive.zh: 后台常驻收取中（长轮询，有消息时立即返回）
fnthinkPresenceLive.en: Persistent background fetching (long polling; returns immediately when a message is available).

fnthinkPresenceLiveNoLock.zh: 后台常驻收取中（长轮询，但系统未授予唤醒锁）
fnthinkPresenceLiveNoLock.en: Persistent background fetching (long polling, but the system did not grant a wake lock).

fnthinkPresencePendingFirstRound.zh: 尚未安排首轮收取（刚启动，首轮完成后将自动安排后续轮次）
fnthinkPresencePendingFirstRound.en: The first round has not been scheduled yet (just started; later rounds are scheduled automatically after the first round completes).

fnthinkPresenceBackoff.zh: 限流退避中：约 {minutes} 分 {seconds} 秒后自动重试（本次为一次性退避，非常规间隔）
fnthinkPresenceBackoff.en: Rate-limit backoff: automatic retry in about {minutes} min {seconds} s (a one-off backoff, not the regular interval).

fnthinkPresenceNext.zh: 下次自动唤醒：{time}（每 {seconds} 秒）

fnthinkPresenceNextNoCadence.zh: 下次自动唤醒：{time}（间隔未知）

fnthinkPresenceStreamHealthy.zh: 实时唤醒已连接 · 兜底间隔 {seconds} 秒

fnthinkPersistQueuedWarning.zh: 本机仍有 {count} 条幻念消息尚未写入收件表，每轮收取开始前将再次尝试写入
fnthinkPersistQueuedWarning.en: {count} Fnthink message(s) are still held locally and have not been written to the inbox; they will be retried before each fetch round starts.

fnthinkPersistAbandonedWarning.zh: 有 {count} 条幻念消息已停止重试（存放超过 24 小时或已尝试 20 次），不会再自动写入收件表
fnthinkPersistAbandonedWarning.en: {count} Fnthink message(s) have stopped being retried (held for over 24 hours or attempted 20 times) and will no longer be written to the inbox automatically.

fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestFailed.zh: 测试通知未能发出（请先检查系统通知权限）
fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestFailed.en: The test notification could not be sent (check the system notification permission first).

fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestSent.zh: 测试通知已发出，请查看锁屏以确认响铃与振动
fnthinkInboxSelfCheckTestSent.en: Test notification sent. Check the lock screen to confirm sound and vibration.

fnthinkInboxSelfCheckRebuilt.zh: 已切换至新的高优先级渠道：{id}
fnthinkInboxSelfCheckRebuilt.en: Switched to a new high-priority channel: {id}

fnthinkInboxIssueChannelMissing.zh: 收件渠道尚未创建（首次收件时将自动创建）
fnthinkInboxIssueChannelMissing.en: Inbox channel not created yet (it will be created automatically on the first message).

fnthinkInboxIssueNoSound.en: No sound is configured for the channel.

fnthinkInboxIssueNotHigh.zh: 渠道已被系统降级（不再显示横幅）
fnthinkInboxIssueNotHigh.en: The channel has been downgraded by the system (heads-up banners are no longer shown).

fnthinkInboxIssueLockscreen.en: Not shown on the lock screen

fnthinkConsentPending.zh: 尚未同意中转：经服务器的收发均已停止
fnthinkConsentPending.en: Relay consent has not been granted; all server-relayed sending and receiving are stopped.

fnthinkConsentNotGranted.zh: 本机尚未同意内容经服务器中转，本次操作未执行
fnthinkConsentNotGranted.en: This device has not consented to relaying content through the server; this action was not performed.

fnthinkConsentRevokeDone.zh: 已撤销：经服务器的收发与远程控制均不可用，配置与历史记录未删除。
fnthinkConsentRevokeDone.en: Revoked: server-relayed sending and receiving, and remote control, are unavailable. No configuration or history was deleted.

fnthinkChannelDisclosureShort.zh: 是否响铃、振动或显示横幅，由系统侧的通知渠道决定
fnthinkChannelDisclosureShort.en: Whether a push sounds, vibrates, or shows a banner is determined by the system-side notification channel.

fnthinkChannelDisclosure.zh: 收到的推送是否响铃、振动或显示横幅，由系统通知设置中的「幻念推送 · 收件」渠道决定。本机已按最高档创建该渠道：重要性为紧急（显示横幅）、声音为系统默认通知音、振动已开启。部分厂商系统（如小米）在该层之上另有按应用管理的悬浮窗与锁屏开关，需在系统设置中核对。
fnthinkChannelDisclosure.en: Whether an incoming push sounds, vibrates, or displays a banner is determined by the "Fnthink Push · Inbox" notification channel in system notification settings. This device creates the channel at the top tier: importance = urgent (heads-up banner), sound = system default notification tone, vibration = on. Some vendor systems (e.g. Xiaomi) provide additional per-app floating-window and lock-screen switches above this layer; these must be checked in system settings.

fnthinkWorkChain.zh: 后台任务：收取 {presenceWork} · 转发 {fanoutWork} · 待发 {queue} 条

fnthinkHealthNever.zh: 协议面未知：暂无协议请求读数
fnthinkHealthNever.en: Protocol plane unknown: no protocol request readings yet

fnthinkDiagWorkerNever.zh: 上次后台轮次：暂无记录
fnthinkDiagWorkerNever.en: Last background round: none recorded yet

fnthinkDiagAlarmNever.zh: 上次闹钟触发：暂无记录
fnthinkDiagAlarmNever.en: Last alarm fired: none recorded yet

fnthinkDiagStreamNever.zh: 上次 SSE 字节：暂无记录
fnthinkDiagStreamNever.en: Last SSE byte: none recorded yet

fnthinkLastRoundNever.zh: 上次成功收取：暂无记录
fnthinkLastRoundNever.en: Last successful fetch: none recorded yet

fnthinkScreenKeepalive.zh: 锁屏持续接收（耗电增加）
fnthinkScreenKeepalive.en: Keep receiving while locked (increases battery use)

fnthinkScreenKeepaliveDesc.zh: 锁屏后仍保持 CPU 唤醒，可更及时收取消息；耗电会明显增加。
fnthinkScreenKeepaliveDesc.en: Keeps the CPU awake while the screen is off so messages arrive sooner; battery use increases noticeably.

fnthinkExactAlarmMissing.zh: 精确闹钟未授权：后台收取可能延迟。
fnthinkExactAlarmMissing.en: Exact alarms not granted: background fetches may be delayed.
